stories.title: Fuzileiro que matou agente da PSP à porta de discoteca de Lisboa com pena aumentada para mais de 23 anos
stories.summary: The Tribunal de Setúbal raised former marine Cláudio Coimbra's prison sentence to 23 years and 9 months by combining two convictions (cúmulo jurídico). One is the 20-year sentence for killing off-duty PSP officer Fábio Guerra, 26, after an assault outside the Mome nightclub in Alcântara, Lisbon, in March 2022. The other is a six-and-a-half-year sentence for assaulting three young people in Sesimbra. The court set the total close to the 25-year legal maximum because he showed no remorse; CM cites Jornal de Notícias as its source.

stories.title: Mix Of The Day: Mika Siponen
stories.summary: Mika Siponen recorded a mix for Hamburg collective PHANTASIA that explores the 'quietly psychedelic history' of Detroit label Underground Resistance. It also takes in wider Detroit house and techno.
